conventions.close_asof: close of the last traded hour of day d-1 (no carry-forward)
conventions.lr: log close - log previous traded close of the same series (rule-B hours only)
conventions.windows: a fixed window that is not complete inside [2024-01-01, d) leaves the value missing; F12-F14 count pairs over d-29..d (>= 20) as in MI
conventions.universe: values are computed for all series and masked per scenario by eligible(d)

q5_parameter_count: number of window parameters, used only as the Q5 tie-break

features.name: ret_1
features.definition: close_asof(d)/close_asof(d-1)-1

features.name: ret_7
features.definition: close_asof(d)/close_asof(d-7)-1

features.name: ret_30
features.definition: close_asof(d)/close_asof(d-30)-1

features.name: ret_30_skip7
features.definition: close_asof(d-7)/close_asof(d-37)-1

features.name: btc_beta_adjusted_ret_30
features.definition: ret_30 - beta_btc_30 * BTC ret_30 (no intercept; not a regression residual); undefined for BTC

features.name: vol_7
features.definition: std (ddof=1) of hourly lr in days d-7..d-1

features.name: vol_30
features.definition: std (ddof=1) of hourly lr in days d-30..d-1

features.name: vol_ratio_7_30
features.definition: vol_7 / vol_30

features.name: downside_vol_30
features.definition: sqrt(mean(min(lr,0)^2)) over days d-30..d-1

features.name: skew_30
features.definition: adjusted Fisher-Pearson skewness G1 = g1*sqrt(n(n-1))/(n-2) of hourly lr, days d-30..d-1

features.name: max_hr_ret_7
features.definition: max hourly lr over days d-7..d-1

features.name: beta_btc_30
features.definition: OLS slope (with intercept) of daily r_1 on BTC r_1 over days d-29..d; undefined for BTC

features.name: corr_btc_30
features.definition: Pearson correlation of the same pairs; undefined for BTC

features.name: idio_vol_30
features.definition: sqrt(SSR/(n-2)) of the F12 regression residuals; undefined for BTC

features.name: log_dv30_med
features.definition: ln(DV30_med) of the universe row of day d (days d-30..d-1)

features.name: thr30
features.definition: THR30 of the universe row of day d

features.name: dv_ratio_7_30
features.definition: median daily quote volume over traded days in d-7..d-1 / same over d-30..d-1

features.name: amihud_30
features.definition: median over days j in d-30..d-1 of |ln(lastclose_j/lastclose_(j-1))| / quote volume_j (USDT)

features.name: traded_min_share_7
features.definition: sum traded_minutes over days d-7..d-1 / 10080

features.name: dist_high_30
features.definition: close_asof(d) / max hourly high over days d-30..d-1 - 1

features.name: dist_low_30
features.definition: close_asof(d) / min hourly low over days d-30..d-1 - 1

features.name: range_7
features.definition: mean over traded days j in d-7..d-1 of (max high_j - min low_j)/last close_j
